_comment: Passed to every plain-* Claude arm via `claude --settings`. Sandboxes Bash (Seatbelt on macOS) with an EMPTY network allowlist. strictAllowlist is load-bearing: in bypassPermissions mode non-allowlisted hosts are otherwise let through. The claude process itself runs outside the sandbox, so api.anthropic.com needs no entry. allowUnsandboxedCommands=false removes the 'retry unsandboxed' escape hatch; failIfUnavailable makes claude exit instead of running unsandboxed when the sandbox cannot start.
